chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abu Ayyub al-Kazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The mother is not excluded from the one-third share if there is no child, except for two brothers or four sisters.
ai.seo_question: When is the mother's one-third inheritance share blocked by siblings?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the application of the 'blocking' (hujb) rule in Shia jurisprudence, specifying that the mother's one-third share is preserved against siblings only when the number of full or half-brothers is two or fewer, or sisters are four or fewer. This precise numerical threshold reflects the detailed exegetical work of the Imams in resolving ambiguities within the Quranic inheritance verses. It highlights the Shia emphasis on the Imams' role in defining the practical boundaries of divine law.
